Topaz
Clan: Nosferatu (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: OBF POT ani for qui
Camarilla: When Topaz successfully equips from your hand, you may look
at your prey's hand, and Topaz may take an equipment from it instead
(discard the original equipment card).

If the two have different costs and you chose the equipment from your
prey's hand, then which cost do you pay?
